name: Alberic de Bordeleaux
canonNotes: Duke of Bordeleaux and Grail Knight, blessed by the Lady with power over the waters.
Defender of Bretonnia's coasts against raiders.
voiceNotes: Courtly, earnest and devout; talks of the sea, the Lady and duty.
Loyal to his king; wary of pirates and sea-raiders.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
